args.prompt: Create a production-ready seamless BASE COLOR ground texture for a bright floating cloud-island in a charming stylized Three.js cat fantasy adventure game. Exact straight-down orthographic view of a continuous flat meadow; the entire square canvas is the ground surface, edge to edge. Clean softly painted game art, rounded simple grass tufts and small leaves, delicate texture variation, bright fresh colors, readable at handheld game scale, neither photorealistic nor a flat textile pattern. Grass dominates over 92 percent of the area. Flowers are small ground-level accents, sparse and naturally scattered, with irregular even density across the whole tile; no bouquet, large blossom, focal patch, orderly rows or symmetric decorative pattern. Keep grass scale small and consistent, distribute details evenly to all edges; no center vignette, no broad brightness gradient, no border or circular island edge. All four sides and corners must visually connect when repeated 2x2 and 4x4; grass clusters and individual flower shapes crossing an edge continue at the opposite edge. Use flat neutral diffuse illumination, no baked directional shadows, no shiny specular spots, no sunlight beams or ambient occlusion creases; engine creates daylight. No soil holes, dirt path, paving, clouds, horizon, sky, floating island silhouette, trees, rocks, objects, people, cats, letters, UI, watermark or contact sheet. One single square texture, requested 2048x2048 at the highest available native resolution. Variant MINT BLOOM: soft light mint and fresh pale lime-green short grass, based around #9AD87A with mint-green #A7DCA4 patches and slightly darker soft sage tufts. Very sparse tiny five-petal cream-white and pale blush-pink flowers, small yellow centers, petals only a little brighter than the grass. Keep the overall impression airy, green and clean. No large dark vegetation.
